name: Banco Central do Brasil - MCP
description: MCP server for Brazilian Central Bank (SGS/BCB) time series — Selic, IPCA, exchange rates, GDP and 150+ economic indicators, queried live from AI assistants.
author: Sidney Bissoli

tools.name: bcb_serie_valores
tools.description: Query values of a BCB time series by code. Returns historical data with date and value, optionally filtered by a date range.

codigo.description: Series code in SGS/BCB (e.g. 433 for monthly IPCA, 11 for Selic)

tools.name: bcb_serie_ultimos
tools.description: Get the last N values of a BCB time series. Useful for the most recent data.

quantidade.description: How many values to return (1-1000, default 10)

tools.name: bcb_serie_metadados
tools.description: Get metadata for a BCB time series: name, frequency, category and other details.

tools.name: bcb_series_populares
tools.description: List 150+ BCB time series with their codes: interest rates, inflation, exchange, GDP, employment, credit and other economic indicators.

categoria.description: Filter by category (Juros, Inflação, Câmbio, Atividade Econômica, Emprego, Fiscal, Setor Externo, Crédito, Agregados Monetários, Poupança, Índices de Mercado, Expectativas)

tools.name: bcb_buscar_serie
tools.description: Search the internal catalog by name or description. Accent-insensitive (e.g. 'inflacao' finds 'Inflação').

tools.name: bcb_indicadores_atuais
tools.description: Get the latest values of the key economic indicators: Selic, IPCA, USD PTAX and IBC-Br.

tools.name: bcb_variacao
tools.description: Compute the percentage variation of a series between two dates or over the last N periods. Useful for trend analysis.

dataInicial.description: Start date (yyyy-MM-dd or dd/MM/yyyy). Defaults to the first available value.

dataFinal.description: End date (yyyy-MM-dd or dd/MM/yyyy). Defaults to the last available value.

periodos.description: Alternative: variation over the last N periods (ignores dates if provided)

tools.name: bcb_comparar
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 time series over the same period. Useful for correlation analysis between indicators.

codigos.description: Array of 2 to 5 series codes to compare

resources.name: series_populares
resources.description: Catalog of 150+ popular BCB economic series, organized by category (JSON)

resources.name: categorias
resources.description: List of available categories in the BCB series catalog (JSON)

resources.name: codigos_principais
resources.description: Codes of the most-used economic indicators — Selic, IPCA, USD, GDP, etc. (JSON)

prompts.name: indicadores_atuais
prompts.description: Query Brazil's key economic indicators (Selic, IPCA, USD/BRL, IBC-Br)

prompts.name: panorama_economico
prompts.description: Generate a complete overview of the Brazilian economy with the main indicators

prompts.name: comparar_inflacao
prompts.description: Compare Brazil's main inflation indices (IPCA, IGP-M, INPC) over the last 12 months
